# SourceShelf

> SourceShelf is a local-first research library for Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Capture webpages, import documents, organize sources into research packs, read saved material offline, and move focused context into compatible AI workflows.

SourceShelf processes imported content locally and keeps research in portable formats such as Markdown, OKF bundles, AI Reference Packs, and llms.txt collections. The complete English user guide is indexed below so AI applications can acquire it as one ordered research collection.

## Product

- [SourceShelf Home](https://sourceshelf.app/)
  Learn about SourceShelf's local-first research workflows across Mac, iPhone, and iPad.

- [Features](https://sourceshelf.app/#how-it-works)
  Explore capture, conversion, research packs, AI access, and export workflows.

- [Download SourceShelf](https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/sourceshelf/id6785887729?mt=12)
  Download SourceShelf from the App Store.

## Complete User Guide

  Browse the complete SourceShelf 1.0.2 guide for Mac, iPhone, and iPad.

  Convert files, review the Library, build an ordered pack, and choose an export format.

- [Capture from Safari on Mac](https://sourceshelf.app/docs/guides/safari-capture/)
  Capture pages, selections, research highlights, or several tabs from a Safari window.

- [Convert Files and Folders](https://sourceshelf.app/docs/guides/convert-files/)
  Convert supported files and folders into local Markdown while preserving useful structure and assets.

- [Library and Inspector](https://sourceshelf.app/docs/guides/library-and-inspector/)
  Search, filter, inspect, preview, and maintain converted and captured sources in the SourceShelf Library.

  Review SourceShelf storage use, run safe cleanup, and deliberately remove generated source data.

- [Build and Manage Packs](https://sourceshelf.app/docs/guides/build-and-manage-packs/)
  Create ordered SourceShelf packs, manage drafts and saved packs, and maintain living export baselines.

- [Choose an Export Format](https://sourceshelf.app/docs/guides/export-formats/)
  Choose among AI Reference Pack, OKF, Markdown, portable llms.txt, collection-folder, and clipboard workflows.

- [Trust and Safety and Living Packs](https://sourceshelf.app/docs/guides/trust-safety-and-refresh/)
  Review pack readiness, trust warnings, freshness, checksums, assets, and living-pack changes.

  Import local collections, acquire website collections through Safari, and generate ordered llms.txt exports.

- [Capture from Safari on iPhone and iPad](https://sourceshelf.app/docs/ios/safari-capture/)
  Enable the extension, capture pages or a Safari window, and import website llms.txt collections.

- [Import and Read Documents on iPhone and iPad](https://sourceshelf.app/docs/ios/import-and-read/)
  Import from Files or the Share Sheet, use local OCR and search, and read saved research offline.

- [Build, Export, and Move Packs on iPhone and iPad](https://sourceshelf.app/docs/ios/packs-and-portability/)

- [Settings and Privacy on iPhone and iPad](https://sourceshelf.app/docs/ios/settings-and-privacy/)
  Review local storage, Safari access, import and export controls, and the no-account, no-sync privacy model.

- [Connect SourceShelf to LM Studio](https://sourceshelf.app/docs/mcp/lm-studio/)

- [Use SourceShelf with Ollama](https://sourceshelf.app/docs/mcp/ollama/)
  Use an Ollama model with a SourceShelf MCP connection hosted by Codex, Claude Code, or OpenCode.

- [Connect SourceShelf to OpenCode](https://sourceshelf.app/docs/mcp/opencode/)

  Diagnose SourceShelf MCP connection, authorization, resource, checksum, search, and client issues.

## Privacy

- [SourceShelf Privacy](https://sourceshelf.app/privacy.html)
  Learn how SourceShelf handles local processing, Safari access, storage, export, and user data.

## Key Concepts

SourceShelf concepts:

- Local-first document conversion and OCR
- Safari webpage and llms.txt capture
- Searchable offline research libraries
- Ordered and portable research packs
- AI Reference Packs and retrieval-ready context
- Open Knowledge Format (OKF)
- llms.txt collections
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Read-only local AI access on Mac

## Product Principles

SourceShelf follows these principles:

- User-owned files.
- Local processing.
- Portable formats.
- Explicit Safari and AI permissions.
- No SourceShelf cloud or hidden synchronization.
